prompt: I want to learn counters while adding one to this project. Explain the first step and let me write it; I will ask if I want you to implement.
criteria: Explains the relevant counter concept with a brief project-specific example before presenting a manageable next step.
Preserves the learner’s opportunity to write the code and does not edit it without being asked.
Responds to follow-up implementation requests by carrying out the work while explaining key decisions, rather than insisting on a quiz.
Keeps guidance concise and uses a diagram only when it makes the concept clearer.
setup: Continue with scripted turns: first supply a learner attempt, then ask the agent to implement. Use the same script in each run.
